chapterInfo.content:
8
1Na ɛberɛ a Samuel bɔɔ akora no, ɔde ne mma sisii Israel so atemmufoɔ. 2#1 Be 6.28 Na n’abakan din de Yoel, na deɛ ɔka ho no de Abiya; wɔyɛɛ atemmufoɔ wɔ Beer-seba. 3#Deut 16.19 Nanso ne mma amfa n’akwan so, na wɔmane kɔdii mfasoɔ akyi, na wɔgyegyee adanmudeɛ, na wɔbubuu ntɛnkyea.
Israelfoɔ hwehwɛ ɔhene
4 # 1 Sa 7.17 Ɛnna Israel mpanimfoɔ nyinaa hyia baa Samuel nkyɛn wɔ Rama 5#Deut 17.14; Hos 13.10; Aso 13.21 bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, woabɔ akora, na wo mma mfa w’akwan so. Afei si ɔhene ma yɛn na ɔnni yɛn so te sɛ amanaman nyinaa. 6Na asɛm no ansɔ Samuel ani sɛ wɔkaa sɛ: Ma yɛn ɔhene na ɔnni yɛn so no. Na Samuel bɔɔ AWURADE mpaeɛ. 7Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Samuel sɛ: Tie deɛ ɔman no seɛ ne deɛ wɔka kyerɛ woɔ no nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ wo na wɔapo woɔ, na me na wɔapo me, sɛ mennni wɔn so hene. 8Wɔn nneyɛɛ a wɔayɛ nyinaa firi da a meyii wɔn Misraim baeɛ de bɛduru nnɛ yi de agyaa me akɔsom anyame foforɔ no, saa ara na wɔreyɛ wo nso yi. 9Enti, afei tie wɔn; na kasa kyerɛ wɔn, na kyerɛ wɔn ɔhene a ɔbɛdi wɔn soɔ no atemmudeɛ.
10Na Samuel kaa AWURADE nsɛm no nyinaa kyerɛɛ ɔman no a wɔbisaa ne hɔ ɔhene no. 11Na ɔkaa sɛ: Yei ne ɔhene a ɔbɛdi mo soɔ no atemmudeɛ: Ɔbɛfa mo mmammarima de wɔn akɔ ne nteaseɛnam ne n’apɔnkɔsotefoɔ mu, na wama wɔatu mmirika adi ne nteaseɛnam anim sɛ awɛmfoɔ, 12na ɔde wɔn asisi mpempem so asafohene ne aduonum so asafohene afa, na wama wɔadɔ n’asase na wɔatwa ne nnɔbaeɛ, na wɔayɛ n’akodeɛ ne ne nteaseɛnam ho adeɛ. 13Na ɔbɛfa mo mmammaa ayɛ adufrafoɔ ne soodofoɔ ne paanootofoɔ. 14Na ɔbɛfa mo mfuo ne mo bobe nturo mu deɛ ɛyɛ de ama ne nkoa. 15Na ɔbɛgye mo ayufuo ne bobe nturo mu aba mu ntotosoɔ du du de ama gyaasefoɔ ne ne nkoa. 16Na ɔbɛfa mo nkoa ne mo mfenaa, ne mo mmeranteɛ a wɔn ho tua wɔn ho, ne mo mfunumu de ayɛ n’adwuma. 17Ɔbɛgye mo nnwan mu ntotosoɔ du du. Na mobɛyɛ ne nkoa. 18Na da no, mo hene a moayi no adi mo soɔ no nti mobɛsu afrɛ, nanso AWURADE remmua mo da no.
19Na ɔman no ampene sɛ wɔtie Samuel, na wɔkaa sɛ: Dabi, na ɔhene ara na ɔnni yɛn soɔ, 20na yɛn nso yɛnyɛ sɛ amanaman nyinaa, na yɛn hene no mmu yɛn atɛn, na ɔmfiri adi nni yɛn anim nni ako mma yɛn. 21Na Samuel tee ɔman no nsɛm nyinaa no, ɔka guu AWURADE aso mu. 22#1 Sa 8.7, 9 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Samuel sɛ: Tie wɔn, na si hene ma wɔn. Na Samuel ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ nyinaa sɛ: Monkɔ mo nkuro mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na ɛberɛ a Samuel bɔɔ akora no, ɔde ne mma sisii Israel so atemmufoɔ. Na n’abakan din de Yoel, na deɛ ɔka ho no de Abiya; wɔyɛɛ atemmufoɔ wɔ Beer-seba. Nanso ne mma amfa n’akwan so, na wɔmane kɔdii mfasoɔ akyi, na wɔgyegyee adanmudeɛ, na wɔbubuu ntɛnkyea.

Ɛnna Israel mpanimfoɔ nyinaa hyia baa Samuel nkyɛn wɔ Rama bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, woabɔ akora, na wo mma mfa w’akwan so. Afei si ɔhene ma yɛn na ɔnni yɛn so te sɛ amanaman nyinaa. Na asɛm no ansɔ Samuel ani sɛ wɔkaa sɛ: Ma yɛn ɔhene na ɔnni yɛn so no. Na Samuel bɔɔ AWURADE mpaeɛ. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Samuel sɛ: Tie deɛ ɔman no seɛ ne deɛ wɔka kyerɛ woɔ no nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ wo na wɔapo woɔ, na me na wɔapo me, sɛ mennni wɔn so hene. Wɔn nneyɛɛ a wɔayɛ nyinaa firi da a meyii wɔn Misraim baeɛ de bɛduru nnɛ yi de agyaa me akɔsom anyame foforɔ no, saa ara na wɔreyɛ wo nso yi. Enti, afei tie wɔn; na kasa kyerɛ wɔn, na kyerɛ wɔn ɔhene a ɔbɛdi wɔn soɔ no atemmudeɛ.
Na Samuel kaa AWURADE nsɛm no nyinaa kyerɛɛ ɔman no a wɔbisaa ne hɔ ɔhene no. Na ɔkaa sɛ: Yei ne ɔhene a ɔbɛdi mo soɔ no atemmudeɛ: Ɔbɛfa mo mmammarima de wɔn akɔ ne nteaseɛnam ne n’apɔnkɔsotefoɔ mu, na wama wɔatu mmirika adi ne nteaseɛnam anim sɛ awɛmfoɔ, na ɔde wɔn asisi mpempem so asafohene ne aduonum so asafohene afa, na wama wɔadɔ n’asase na wɔatwa ne nnɔbaeɛ, na wɔayɛ n’akodeɛ ne ne nteaseɛnam ho adeɛ. Na ɔbɛfa mo mmammaa ayɛ adufrafoɔ ne soodofoɔ ne paanootofoɔ. Na ɔbɛfa mo mfuo ne mo bobe nturo mu deɛ ɛyɛ de ama ne nkoa. Na ɔbɛgye mo ayufuo ne bobe nturo mu aba mu ntotosoɔ du du de ama gyaasefoɔ ne ne nkoa. Na ɔbɛfa mo nkoa ne mo mfenaa, ne mo mmeranteɛ a wɔn ho tua wɔn ho, ne mo mfunumu de ayɛ n’adwuma. Ɔbɛgye mo nnwan mu ntotosoɔ du du. Na mobɛyɛ ne nkoa. Na da no, mo hene a moayi no adi mo soɔ no nti mobɛsu afrɛ, nanso AWURADE remmua mo da no.
Na ɔman no ampene sɛ wɔtie Samuel, na wɔkaa sɛ: Dabi, na ɔhene ara na ɔnni yɛn soɔ, na yɛn nso yɛnyɛ sɛ amanaman nyinaa, na yɛn hene no mmu yɛn atɛn, na ɔmfiri adi nni yɛn anim nni ako mma yɛn. Na Samuel tee ɔman no nsɛm nyinaa no, ɔka guu AWURADE aso mu. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Samuel sɛ: Tie wɔn, na si hene ma wɔn. Na Samuel ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ nyinaa sɛ: Monkɔ mo nkuro mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
